question: If Demonlord of Ashmouth returns to the battlefield because of undying, does its 'when this creature enters' ability trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the enters ability triggers no matter how it entered, including through undying.
expected.answer: Demonlord of Ashmouth's "enters" ability will trigger no matter how it entered, including because of its undying ability.
